sector_neutral_spread_formula.definition: S_t = sum_{s in S} (N_{Q5, s} / |Q5|) * (R_{Q5, s, t} - R_{U, s, t})
sector_neutral_spread_formula.eligible_universe_in_sector: R_{U, s, t} includes all eligible stocks in sector s (including Q5 members)
sector_neutral_spread_formula.monopoly_sector_rule: If sector s contains only Q5 stocks in eligible universe, spread for sector s is set to 0
sector_neutral_spread_formula.execution: Computed via identical JT sleeve engine with sector-filtered schedules

interpretation_gate.rule: Crowding effect confirmed ONLY IF primary is statistically significant AND sector-neutral spread < 0. Otherwise classified as Sector Exposure.
interpretation_gate.null_conclusion: Failure to reject implies no crowding effect larger than 1.40% per 10 sessions detected.

shadow_run_protocol.purpose: Feed health verification, capture timing check, anomaly logging, zero return peeking.
